subject: MAP: Acceptance cadence & signature lane — Meridian Bio pilot
messages:
From: Claire Jenkins <cjenkins@meridianbio.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Victor Long <victor.long@meridianbio.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff & dependencies for Meridian pilot

Neha — thanks for the quick intro earlier. We want to lock an MAP that ties the evaluation milestones to signature windows for the MSA/DPA/order form. High level asks from our side:

- Clear evidence list for SOC2 / logging (we’ll feed this to security).
- Which doc do we expect to sign first (MSA vs order form) and target sign dates so Procurement can set approval board slots.
- Any non-negotiable gating items (KMS, data residency notes) that will block activation.

Can you share a proposed lane plan with dates? We prefer a short path (4–6 weeks) if legal turnaround is reasonable — otherwise we’ll need to align on a phased activation (pilot-only first).

Thanks — Claire
Claire Jenkins
Head of Procurement, Meridian Bio
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Jenkins <cjenkins@meridianbio.com>, Victor Long <victor.long@meridianbio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff & dependencies for Meridian pilot

Claire — thanks, copying Karthik (Legal sequencing) and Marissa (Solutions/CS). Draft lane plan attached — short summary below and the MAP doc in Google Drive: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aMeridian-MAP-plan

Proposed high-level cadence (timeline = business days):
- Week 0 (today): MAP shared; Procurement confirms internal approval windows.
- Week 1: Redwood provides evidence checklist + SOC2 excerpt; Meridian shares any mandatory legal must-haves.
- Week 2: Redwood provides MSA redline (v2 attached) + draft order form.
- Week 3: Meridian returns consolidated redline / comments.
- Week 4: Finalize documents; target signature window (DocuSign) end of Week 4.

If Procurement requires the MSA first (common), we can sign MSA + DPA and treat order form as an activation addendum to be signed same week. Alternate flow: sign order form for pilot access earlier and MSA within 2 weeks of pilot start.

Attachments: MSA_redline_v2.pdf (pdf), MAP-evidence-checklist.xlsx (xlsx), OrderForm-draft-2026-09.docx (docx)

Next steps: can we confirm your approval board dates and an internal point of contact for legal? I’ll ask Karthik to call out sequencing constraints that would force a phased activation.

— Neha Kapoor
Sr. Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Jenkins <cjenkins@meridianbio.com>, Victor Long <victor.long@meridianbio.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff & dependencies for Meridian pilot

Claire / team — thanks for looping me in. A few legal sequencing notes and constraints that affect the lane plan:

1) Preferred flow:
   - Execute MSA + DPA together (single signing session) to clear data handling concerns.
   - Order form can be signed concurrently or immediately after; signing order form first is OK for pilot access but we need a binding DPA commitment before any production PII is processed.

2) Non-negotiables that will pause activation:
   - KMS integration timeline: if you require customer-managed keys we need 3–4 weeks to validate HSM integration and update deployment configs.
   - Audit log retention SLA: if your security team needs >24 months retention with on-prem export, that triggers additional engineering gating.

3) Redline guidance (attached annotations in MSA_redline_v2.pdf):
   - Limit liability cap adjustments: we can be flexible within a 3x ARR band; larger asks will need legal exec approval.
   - Data residency: we can commit to region-based tenancy for US/EU; APAC requires separate booking.

If Meridian confirms: (a) MSA+DPA signing slot available in Week 4 and (b) no customer-managed KMS requirement, the 4-week timeline is achievable. Otherwise plan for a phased activation: order form -> pilot (limited tokens) -> full activation after MSA/DPA complete.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Jenkins <cjenkins@meridianbio.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Victor Long <victor.long@meridianbio.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff & dependencies for Meridian pilot

Neha / Karthik — appreciate the clarity. Quick answers from Procurement/Legal:

- Procurement board has the next slot on 2026-09-22 (Week 4 window).
- We do not require customer-managed KMS for pilot; target is Redwood-managed keys with an option to revisit later.
- Data residency: US-only for pilot, full US/EU after contract execution.

Given that, we want to:
- Receive final MSA+DPA redline by 2026-09-10 (so our legal can consolidate prior to the board).
- Order form for pilot access signed by 2026-09-15 (pilot starts 09-20).

Sending our internal contact: Victor Long (victor.long@meridianbio.com) will handle the legal redline coordination. Please send us a DocuSign template and confirm who will be the signatory for Redwood (exec or authorized sales sign-off).

Thanks — Claire
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Jenkins <cjenkins@meridianbio.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff & dependencies for Meridian pilot

Claire / Victor — great, we’re aligned. Action items from Redwood: 

- Legal (Karthik) will deliver consolidated MSA_redline_v3.pdf by 2026-09-10 (attached as stub).
- I’ll prepare the order form and a DocuSign envelope (template: Redwood-MSA-v2) and send the envelope to Victor + designated Meridian signatory by 2026-09-12.
- MAP-evidence-checklist.xlsx has been updated to include SOC2 excerpts, logging endpoints, and KMS notes for pilot — link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aMeridian-MAP-plan (row comments show ownership).

Note: If board approval moves earlier, we’ll accelerate the redline delivery. Otherwise we’re on path to pilot start 2026-09-20 with limited token capacity until full activation post-signature.

Attachments: MSA_redline_v3.pdf (pdf) — draft final; OrderForm-draft-2026-09.docx (updated)

— Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
